_note: Test customer type: Small Nordic SaaS companies selling upmarket. Product kvitto, pricing flat (flat plans, annual or monthly, plus a self-serve tier). Fictional.
offer: Kvitto gets small B2B software companies audit-ready for SOC 2 Type I or ISO 27001 in about 8 weeks, without hiring a compliance person.

triggers: Selling to banks, insurers or the public sector

product_info: Kvitto connects to the customer's cloud, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, GitHub and HR system, collects audit evidence automatically and generates the policies an auditor expects for SOC 2 Type I or ISO 27001. A named compliance lead answers security questionnaires with the customer for three months. Median 9 weeks from kickoff to audit-ready.
tone: Plain, short and specific. No hype words and no exclamation marks. One clear ask. Max 120 words for a first email.

auto_close.standard_terms: List price, standard terms, no custom contract

pricing.deal_policy: Discounts above 10% need an admin. Never above 20%.
